name: an editor's other lists are not recognised
why: Without _MB_POP_EDITLIST_RE in _mbPopParsePath() the profile's 'view' links to /user/<name>/edits/<status> and /user/<name>/votes have no card.

edits.find: if (_MB_POP_EDITLIST_RE.test(pathname)) return { seg: '', type: 'edits', id: pathname };

name: the link's query is not passed
why: An edit search is told by its query (conditions.); without a.search no /search/edits link is a target.

name: page= is kept in a search's id
why: The id must not carry page=: the pager appends its own, and the same search linked from page 3 would be another record.

name: a form_only search is a target
why: An edit list's Quick links open the prefilled form, which lists nothing: no card.

name: an edit search is kept in IndexedDB
why: A search's conditions may be relative ('24 hours ago'): it stays in memory only, so a reload asks again.

name: the applications are kept in IndexedDB
why: Account data, not an entity: memory only, so a reload asks again (and a login page then fails).

name: every application column is read
why: Only _MB_APPS_COLS may be read: the Actions cell holds 'Revoke access', a developer application's row its OAuth client id and secret.

edits.find: const keep = heads.map((h, i) => (_MB_APPS_COLS.has(h) ? i : -1)).filter(i => i >= 0);

name: a list's window is titled 'Editing history'
why: titleOf() names the window per id: 'Rejected edits', 'Votes', 'Edit search'.

name: subscribers and applications are not recognised
why: Without _MB_POP_ACCOUNT_RE's branch the profile's two 'view list' links have no card.

edits.find: if (a) return a[2] ? { seg: '', type: 'subscribers', id: a[1] } : { seg: '', type: 'applications', id: 'me' };

name: the anonymous subscribers are not counted
why: 'Plus N other anonymous users' is the only place the page says how many are anonymous.
